injuries.comment: Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.
Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Ingram (heel/Achilles) will remain on the inactive list for Thursday's game in San Antonio.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Stewart (illness) won't play Wednesday against the Cavs.
Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game in Cleveland.
Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Rollins (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game at Miami.
Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
Pullin (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks.
Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks, Charlie Walton of ZoneCoverage.com reports.
Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Williams (rest) is listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Bucks.
Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.
Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.
Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Minnesota.
Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Harper (hip) won't play in Thursday's game against the Clippers, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
